items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: And Toby Hardwick on saxophone and the Sheet, trumpet. Sonny Greer playing drums.

ctx.x: And Toby Hardwick on saxophone and the Sheet, trumpet. Sonny Greer playing drums. So Clarence and I had this big argument and said we'll break up. Clarence had this in mind anyhow. He saw an opportunity. So, he went to Showden and said, 'I've got a job for you.' In the meantime we'd had the entire Polley circuit booked which is six and a half weeks with the act. Now, when we broke up and Clarence

said, 'Go ahead, I got a group. I can take -- I got a group, I'll take over that (unintelligible).' So I said we'll beat him to it. So I got into New York early Monday morning and I went down to the Palace Theater office and told them that Clarence was bringing in a brand new act. I had the original band, which I did have -- the band went with me. I had the original band and he's bringing a brand new band.
